## Workload

Elif Sahin graded 673 sets during 458 rostered hours. This represents an average rate of 1.5 sets per hour. The workload was reviewed against the rostered time available, and the current session pattern was considered appropriate for the work completed.

## Quality

A sample of 60 sets was checked again as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 73.3 per cent. This result was considered alongside the volume of work completed and the available review sample. Elif Sahin and Priya Anand agreed to retain the current session pattern.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
